# {{ site.title }}

> Official personal website of Davide Bettio, creator of AtomVM, an open-source
> virtual machine for running Erlang and Elixir on microcontrollers and
> resource-constrained devices.

Davide Bettio is an open-source software engineer from Padova, Italy.
He created AtomVM and currently works full-time on its development.
He previously contributed to KDE and co-created Astarte, an open-source IoT
platform. He has been interested in embedded systems since 2003.

He organizes the Erlang, Elixir, Gleam and Friends devroom at FOSDEM and has
spoken about AtomVM at conferences including Code BEAM Europe, ElixirConf EU,
FOSDEM and Goatmire.
